$comment: `exclude` replaces the base list rather than extending it, so every entry the root
tsconfig excludes has to be repeated here. Leaving `website` out meant `bob build`
type-checked the documentation site against the library's `lib: [ESNext]` and failed
on ResizeObserver and the Docusaurus `@site/*` aliases — during `npm pack`, which is
the worst place to discover it.
